definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something together with someone or something. More formal than {一緒|いっしょ}に.
Indicates that something applies to both parties or items mentioned.

definitions.gloss: as, at the same time as
definitions.explanation: Used in the pattern 〜と{共|とも}に to mean 'as ~ happens' or 'along with ~'.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}と{共|とも}に{過|す}ごす{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: I value the time I spend with my family.

examples.japanese: {苦|くる}しみも{喜|よろこ}びも{共|とも}に{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う。
examples.english: We share both hardships and joys together.

examples.japanese: {時代|じだい}と{共|とも}に{変|か}わっていく。
examples.english: It changes along with the times.

notes:
USAGE: {共|とも}に is more formal and literary than {一緒|いっしょ}に. It's commonly used in written Japanese and formal speech.

PATTERNS:
・〜と{共|とも}に (together with ~)
・AもBも{共|とも}に (both A and B)
・〜と{共|とも}に (as ~, along with ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{共|とも}に{生|い}きる (to live together)
・{共|とも}に{働|はたら}く (to work together)
・{共|とも}に{学|まな}ぶ (to learn together)
・{苦楽|くらく}を{共|とも}にする (to share joys and sorrows)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{一緒|いっしょ}に - together (casual)
・{連|つ}れて - taking along
・と{同時|どうじ}に - at the same time as
